d: The IT Project Manager will lead and coordinate the planning, execution, and delivery of critical technology initiatives. The role requires strong leadership and communication skills, along with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams and manage project milestones. The individual will be responsible for ensuring high-quality project outcomes are delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget.
The role will primarily focus on cybersecurity projects; therefore, prior experience in managing and delivering cybersecurity initiatives will be considered a strong advantage.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an advantage.
5+ years of experience managing medium to large IT projects.
Proven track record of successfully delivering projects within scope, on time, and within budget.
Hands-on experience with project management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello, or similar).
Experience managing cybersecurity projects (e.g., SOC, IAM, GRC, network, endpoint, or data security) is a strong advantage.
Working knowledge of security frameworks and controls (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, or equivalent) is an advantage.
Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or similar Agile certifications.
Cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, or CompTIA Security+ are an advantage.
Strong understanding of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Familiarity with system integrations, software development processes, and IT infrastructure.
Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
Working understanding of core security domains, including threat and vulnerability management, identity and access management, network and endpoint security, and incident response.
Ability to interpret audit findings, risk registers, and remediation plans and translate them into clear project tasks, owners, and deadlines.
Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Arabic and English to effectively liaise with stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional project teams, fostering a collaborative environment.
Skilled in risk analysis, contingency planning, and problem resolution.
Adept at understanding complex business and technical issues and implementing pragmatic solutions.
Proven ability to build rapport with clients, vendors, and team members.
Effective negotiation skills to address conflicting requirements and manage expectations.
Meticulous tracking of project documentation, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
Strong attention to timelines, resources, and quality standards.
r: Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, and budget estimation.
Identify project dependencies and manage potential risks and constraints.
Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication of tasks and responsibilities.
Track project performance against established objectives, milestones, and deliverables.
Implement change management processes to accommodate shifting requirements.
Proactively identify, analyze, and resolve project-related risks and issues.
Develop contingency plans and communicate risk mitigation strategies to stakeholders.
Escalate critical issues to senior management as necessary.

Lead the delivery of cybersecurity initiatives such as security operations, identity and access management, vulnerability and patch management, security tooling rollouts, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) workstreams.
Coordinate with security architects, SOC and infrastructure teams, and specialist vendors to ensure project deliverables align with the organization’s security architecture and control framework.
Track security risks, audit findings, and remediation actions through to closure, ensuring documentation and supporting evidence are maintained for internal and regulatory reviews.
Ensure deliverables comply with applicable security standards and policies (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, and Qatar’s National Information Assurance Policy).
Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the project team.
Prepare and present regular status reports, progress updates, and project dashboards.
Facilitate project meetings, document outcomes, and track action items for follow-up.
Communicate confidently and effectively in Arabic with regional and local stakeholders, ensuring project requirements are clearly understood.
Allocate internal and external resources effectively to optimize productivity.
Manage third-party vendors and contractors, ensuring they meet project standards and deadlines.
Review and approve project-related expenses while adhering to budget constraints.
Define and monitor quality metrics throughout project lifecycles.
Oversee testing and validation processes to ensure project deliverables meet requirements.
Lead post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.
Implement best practices in project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid).
Advocate continuous improvement to optimize project processes and workflows.
Encourage collaboration and knowledge-sharing to enhance team effectiveness.

d: We are looking for a proactive, agile, and highly organized Junior Project Manager to lead and coordinate our cross-functional marketing and real estate projects. In this role, you will be based in our Dubai office but will focus entirely on projects dedicated to the Georgian market.

‼️ The key requirements for this role are fluent English, being currently based in Dubai (or having recent Dubai-based work experience), and having at least 1.5 years of experience in coordination or project/product management.
Please note: Fluency in Georgian and/or Russian is not mandatory, but will be considered a significant advantage.

You will act as the key bridge between various internal departments (architects, engineers, designers, and sales teams) to ensure seamless communication, while managing and maintaining project-related digital and offline assets, such as websites and marketing materials.
q: Experience: Ideally 1.5+ years of experience in Project Management, Product Management, Coordination, Team Lead, or Business Assistance roles;
Languages: Fluent English (both written and spoken) is mandatory. Fluency in Georgian and/or Russian is a very strong advantage;
Location: Currently based in Dubai or having worked in Dubai within the past few years (and ready for a full-time, office-based role);
Soft Skills: Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills; a flexible mindset with the ability to easily adapt to frequently changing inputs and a fast-paced environment;
Communication: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills;
Tools: Experience with project management tools (Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or similar) is a plus;
Track Record: Previous experience coordinating complex, cross-functional projects is highly preferred.
r: Manage & Coordinate: Drive marketing and real estate projects dedicated to the Georgian market;
Timeline & Execution Owner: Own project timelines, priorities, and cross-functional execution across multiple teams;
Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinate daily with Architecture, Sales, Marketing, Design, and other internal departments;
Asset Management: Monitor, update, and maintain project-related assets, including websites, marketing materials, and printed collateral;
Delivery & Quality: Ensure all project deliverables are completed on time and meet the company’s quality standards;
Risk & Progress Tracking: Track project progress, proactively identify risks, and quickly resolve issues;
Change Management: Adapt swiftly to changing priorities and business needs, keeping fast-paced launches on track.
x: Modern office in prime Dubai locations;
Exciting opportunity to grow within the international real estate and tech ecosystem;
Clear paths for professional growth and career development.

d: We are seeking a professional, customer-focused, and highly motivated Remote Customer Satisfaction Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, providing exceptional support, addressing inquiries, resolving complaints, and ensuring a positive customer experience across multiple communication channels.

As a Customer Service Representative, you will be responsible for assisting customers with questions about our products and services, processing requests, troubleshooting basic issues, handling complaints, and providing accurate information in a timely and professional manner.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a strong problem-solving ability, patience, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. You should be comfortable using computers, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, email platforms, live chat applications, and other digital communication tools.

This position requires someone who is passionate about helping people, capable of managing multiple customer inquiries, and committed to maintaining high standards of customer satisfaction and service quality.
Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries through phone calls, emails, live chat, and other approved communication channels.
Provide accurate information regarding company products, services, policies, procedures, pricing, and account-related questions.
Listen carefully to customers to understand their needs, concerns, and expectations.
Maintain a friendly, patient, and professional attitude when interacting with customers.
Guide customers through processes, account updates, product usage, and general service inquiries.
Follow up with customers when necessary to ensure their concerns have been properly addressed.
Identify customer concerns and provide appropriate solutions in a timely and effective manner.
Handle customer complaints, disputes, and service-related issues with empathy and professionalism.
De-escalate difficult conversations and manage dissatisfied customers while maintaining a positive customer experience.
Investigate reported issues and coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complex problems.
Escalate unresolved or sensitive matters to the appropriate supervisor or department.
Take ownership of customer issues and ensure proper follow-through until resolution.
Assist customers with placing orders, tracking shipments, processing cancellations, and managing returns or exchanges, where applicable.
Help customers update personal information, account details, subscriptions, and service preferences.
Verify customer information and maintain accurate records of interactions and transactions.
Provide updates regarding order status, service requests, refunds, and other account-related matters.
Ensure that all customer requests are handled according to company policies and established procedures.
Record customer interactions, inquiries, complaints, and resolutions accurately in the company's CRM or customer support system.
Maintain organized and up-to-date customer records.
Document recurring issues, customer feedback, and frequently reported concerns.
Prepare reports on customer interactions, service requests, and unresolved cases when required.
Ensure that all customer information is handled confidentially and in accordance with company data protection policies.
Build positive relationships with customers through attentive, personalized, and reliable support.
Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and strengthen customer loyalty.
Educate customers about relevant products, services, features, and available solutions.
Collect customer feedback and communicate suggestions for improving products and services.
Represent the company positively in every customer interaction.
Work toward achieving customer satisfaction, first-contact resolution, and service quality targets.
Collaborate with other customer service representatives, supervisors, and internal departments to resolve customer concerns.
Participate in virtual team meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
Stay informed about company policies, product updates, service changes, and customer support procedures.
Follow established workflows, service standards, and communication guidelines.
Identify opportunities to improve customer service processes and operational efficiency.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to take on additional responsibilities when required.
q: High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
Additional education, training, or certification in customer service, business administration, communications, or a related field is an advantage.
Previous experience in customer service, call center operations, sales support, client relations, or a similar role is preferred.
Experience working with customers through phone, email, and live chat is an advantage.
Familiarity with CRM software, help desk platforms, and customer support tools is beneficial.
Candidates with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn may also be considered for entry-level opportunities.
Proficiency in using computers, email applications, web browsers, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
Ability to navigate multiple software applications and digital platforms efficiently.
Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, or Freshdesk is an advantage.
Ability to type accurately and manage multiple customer requests simultaneously.
Basic troubleshooting and digital problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong active listening and comprehension abilities.
Ability to explain information clearly and communicate effectively with people from different backgrounds.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive customer relationships.
Fluency in the required working language(s).
The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate The Following Qualities
Customer-focused: Genuine interest in helping customers and ensuring their satisfaction.
Patient and empathetic: Ability to remain calm, understanding, and respectful when dealing with frustrated or demanding customers.
Problem-solver: Strong analytical thinking and the ability to identify practical solutions.
Reliable and accountable: Consistently meets deadlines, follows procedures, and takes responsibility for assigned tasks.
Detail-oriented: Ensures accuracy when documenting information, processing requests, and communicating with customers.
Organized: Able to prioritize tasks and manage multiple customer inquiries efficiently.
Adaptable: Comfortable learning new technologies, processes, and company policies.
Self-motivated: Able to work independently and remain productive without constant supervision.
Team player: Willing to collaborate, share knowledge, and contribute to team objectives.
Professional: Maintains confidentiality, integrity, and a positive attitude at all times.
Since this is a fully remote position, candidates must have the ability to work effectively from home and maintain a professional working environment.
A functional laptop or desktop computer that meets company technical requirements.
A working headset with a microphone, particularly for roles involving phone support.
A quiet, distraction-free workspace suitable for professional customer interactions.
Basic knowledge of online communication and collaboration tools such as Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Slack.
Ability to manage working hours, meet deadlines, and maintain productivity independently.
Availability to attend virtual meetings, training sessions, and scheduled team check-ins.
Ability to comply with company security requirements and protect confidential customer information.
Performance Expectations and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The Customer Service Representative will be evaluated based on measurable performance indicators, including:
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT): Maintaining high customer satisfaction through professional and effective support.
First Contact Resolution (FCR): Resolving customer concerns during the initial interaction whenever possible.
Response Time: Responding to customer inquiries within established service-level targets.
Average Handling Time (AHT): Managing customer interactions efficiently without compromising service quality.
Quality Assurance Score: Maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and compliance with company communication standards.
